- [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) — Comrade of — [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) — fellow members of the Improvement Society committee · since v2  <sub>[v2 XIV A Danger Averted P49](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0049)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) by being forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after being late to school. Humiliated, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to quit school entirely. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

> At a party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, leading to a fall that breaks Anne's ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) carries [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to realize how deeply she cares for the girl. During her seven weeks of bed rest, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is comforted by visitors, reflects on her mistakes, and looks forward to returning to school to meet her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. > On her thirteenth birthday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to school with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) down the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path), discussing their growing up and Anne's melodramatic composition assignment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) proposes starting a story club, which quickly expands to include other schoolmates. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the club and its moral lessons with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

The Story Club Is Formed P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a restful, active summer outdoors on the [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale) doctor's orders before returning to her studies in autumn. As the school year progresses, she prepares intensely for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams under Miss Stacy's guidance. Meanwhile, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) observes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) growing up into a quieter, taller young woman and privately grieves the passing of Anne's childhood.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), assisted by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and checked by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). After driving over with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) experiences severe stage fright on the hotel platform, but recovers upon seeing [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd and performs brilliantly to enthusiastic applause.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P33](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034)_

> Following her successful recitation and encore at the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is warmly praised by the guests, including a stout pink lady and Mrs. [Evans](../character/evans.md). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) join [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for supper before they leave with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) in his carriage, chatting about wealth, compliments from an artist, and being content with who they are.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers she has won the Avery Scholarship, while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal, and she subsequently celebrates her success at commencement with her loved ones. Returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reconnects with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and learns that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) plans to teach locally instead of attending [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). She also notes signs of aging and ill health in [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), enjoying a serene evening walk with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) in the pasture before hardship strikes.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss the newly formed [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) as they drive through the countryside to canvass for hall repairs. They visit several local residents, dealing with the pessimistic Miss [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md), receiving a secret donation from Catherine, helping Dan Blair mix a cake, and navigating Mrs. Theodore White's extreme cleanliness to gather subscriptions.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P36](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0036)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) residents, visiting Mrs. Theodore White and several other neighbors with varying degrees of success. Learning that [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) has just had a son, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cleverly visits him while he is overjoyed and secures a five-dollar donation. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a contribution, but he refuses.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P37](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0037), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P50](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0050), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) debate Mrs. Lynde's virtues and discuss the village hall painting project. Later, [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with paint numbers, causing dismay among the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Despite the hideous result, public sympathy turns in favor of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and the community rallies around them.
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meet by the stream and make plans to celebrate Anne's chosen spring birthday on Saturday. When Saturday arrives, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) go on a woods walk, naming a hidden pool and exploring back lanes. Eventually, they discover Hester Gray's forgotten garden, where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) shares the touching romantic history of the spot.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P0](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0000), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P8](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0008), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044)_

> After reflecting on Hester Gray's story and imagining her appearance, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) spend the afternoon exploring the woods and eating lunch by a brook. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her poetic thoughts about nature and souls, which [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) finds hard to grasp. As evening falls, the girls return home after a wonderful day, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later leaves narcissus blossoms on Hester's grave.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P56](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0056), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P61](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0061), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P66](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0066), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P73](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0073)_

> Mrs. Lynde tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about preparations for the Ladies' [Aid](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) bazaar and asks to borrow Miss Barry's platter, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns Marilla's sight is improving. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) receives a letter from the twins' uncle extending their stay, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) remembers a conversation with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) after catching him eating plum jam. Later, at an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) announces that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a medicine company for painted ads, prompting a committee of girls to try unsuccessfully to talk him out of it.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) plead with [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) not to rent his fences for advertising, but he refuses. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally witnesses [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md) offering Judson a political bribe. To ensure [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) keeps quiet and doesn't ruin his reputation, Judson agrees to drop the advertisement plan and tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) can have their way.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P65](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0065), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P66](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0066)_

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can go to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts the plan and resigns her teaching position, which causes great sorrow among her students and her friend [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P24](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0024), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_

> The A.V.I.S. throws a farewell party for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before they leave for college, though Anne's evening is somewhat ruined by Gilbert's sentimentality and Charlie Sloane's dull company. The next day, after dealing with discouraging goodbyes from local women, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a peaceful evening walk in the woods with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), restoring her spirits.
>
> — v3 · Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P6](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0006), [v3 ch.Autumn P11](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0011), [v3 ch.Autumn P38](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0038)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling disillusioned after rejecting [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), but learns from [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) that he recovers quickly from heartbreak. She hears [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) gossip from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde, clashes with Mrs. [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md) over Jane's lavish engagement, and attends Phil's wedding in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). Back in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her newborn baby, feeling increasingly lonely as her friends move on into new stages of life.
>
